item.name: Coding Assessment
item.description: Coding challenge system — problems seeded from stater_code/, invite emails, and interview status tracking.

request.description: Returns all seeded problems. Filter by difficulty: ?difficulty=easy|medium|hard
Filter problems by difficulty: easy, medium, or hard.
Returns problem details including baseCode (starter code per language) and visible test cases.
Employer/Interviewer only. Randomly picks problems from the seeded Problem table based on difficultyDistribution. Auto-saves testId to collection variable.
Employer only. Sends a branded HTML invite email to the candidate with a signed token link. expiresInHours is configurable (default: 48). Auto-saves inviteToken to collection variable.
No JWT required — candidates use the invite link token. Returns ordered problems with starter code templates (baseCode) and visible test cases. Token is validated for match and expiry.
No JWT required. Returns: test metadata, per-problem submission status, overall progress (completedProblems/totalProblems), and all submission records with grades and AI review.
JWT-authenticated version for employers/interviewers to check candidate progress.

Submit code for a problem. Runs all test cases via Judge0 self-hosted instance (http://44.222.35.138:2358), then sends to OpenAI for qualitative review and grading (0-100). languageId follows Judge0 IDs: 71=Python3, 63=JavaScript, 62=Java, 54=C++ (GCC 9.2.0), 74=TypeScript, 60=Go, 73=Rust, 72=Ruby.
Run code against all testcases for a problem without saving a submission. Used for immediate feedback to the candidate (e.g., 'Run Code' button).
Mark a test as started (sets startedAt timestamp).
Finalize a test (marks as completed and sets submittedAt).
Get unique tags from all problems to act as topics.
Get all mock tests created by the currently logged-in user.
Get a detailed AI-powered report for a specific test.
